source_clauses: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

requirements.statement: Desk edge thickness must be between 18 and 40 mm.
When tight, the clamp must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
The clamp must be removable and movable to another desk without any tools.

scenarios.description: Attaching a monitor arm to a desk edge using the clamp.
Tightening the clamp so it holds securely.
Removing the clamp from the desk.
Moving the clamp to another desk.

freedoms: The mechanism for clamping is not specified.
The material of the clamp is not specified.
The dimensions of the clamp are not specified.
The weight of the monitor arm is not specified.
The tool-free operation can be achieved by any unspecified means.
ambiguities: The phrase 'under the weight of the arm' does not specify the magnitude or range of that weight.
The phrase 'take it off and move it to another desk' could imply that the entire assembly (clamp and arm) is moved or just the clamp.
The request does not specify if the clamp must fit all desk edges in the given thickness range or if it should be adjustable to fit any thickness.
assumptions: The clamp is intended to be used with a monitor arm; no other usage is implied.
The desk edge thickness range is the only dimension constraint provided.
The clamp must be manually operated without tools; no power tools are implied.
The clamp is to be reused multiple times.
